replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
I have heard that their is a bug in 1.7 Minecraft.
Knockback and the distance someone is able to knock another person relies on when they logged onto the server.

For example, the first person who logged onto the server will be able to knock players back a lot further than the player who just joined.

It is a bug that has been in Minecraft during 1.7 and has been fixed in the new 1.8 update. 

Considering Avicus is still in 1.7 this could be a reason as to why you are experiencing this knockback related problem.

So servers can do 1 of two things to fix this problem.
Either continue running on 1.7 and initiating a plug-in that resolves this issue, or update all servers to 1.8 where this bug has been confirmed to be fixed.

Hope this answered your question!
